unit_definition: 1 CU = wall time of 1,000 MKM state evaluations on the measurement machine (21.8 ms); evaluation-based actions charged by evaluation count, vectorized actions by measured wall time; all costs rounded up to integers

COMPUTE_ACTIVITY.basis: 1 MKM evaluation per metal at the reference condition; charged 1 CU per metal (minimum billable unit)

BUILD_PROCESS_WINDOW.basis: self-consistent recycle fixed point per state: 0.171 ms/state measured over the full library

OPTIMIZE_PROCESS.basis: 2 MKM evaluations per not-yet-evaluated state (descriptor bracketing as in the frozen closure) -> states*2/1000 CU

READ_COST_BREAKDOWN.basis: bookkeeping on an already optimized state

RUN_MC.basis: per (draw x metal): interpolation on the response-surface asset + full-window cost minimization; wall time measured; the response-surface asset (14136 x 1201 evaluations) is a shared precomputed Layer-A asset, not charged

TEST_LEVER.basis: re-optimization of an already evaluated metal under a perturbed economic/engineering parameter; wall time measured

BACKWARD.basis: root search over the activity multiplier, each iteration a full-window re-optimization; wall time measured

TEST_REACHABILITY.basis: reference scope: 1201 MKM evaluations along the descriptor grid; window scope adds the state-wise maximum on the response-surface asset

CHECK_MODEL_VALIDITY.basis: bookkeeping, except the exact dominance check on a not-yet-evaluated metal, which costs its state evaluation (2 per state)
